svg.title: Banneret — passive tree, clusters
svg.desc: One passive tree shared by the party, laid out as clusters whose node arrangement draws a shape hinting at its effect, with plain paths and empty space between them. A ring road links the three hero starts. Each hero has four class clusters: berserker claw marks, reaver chalice, paladin shield, spellblade sword, wizard spiral, druid leaf, priest sun, warlock pentagram, hexblade eye, duelist crossed blades, assassin flask, ranger arrow. Each class cluster ends in its class keystone, which leads to three small ascension clusters. Mechanic clusters sit between classes: a blood drop for bleed between berserker and ranger, a flame for fire, a crescent for curses, a banner, a ward and haste chevrons. Node colour codes the mechanic; arcs around a node show which heroes took it. Sample mid-run with the warrior selected. Names, counts and allocations are illustrative. Static SVG mockup.
svg.text: LAYOUT TEST · mid-run sample. Each cluster's shape hints at its effect. Node colour = mechanic. Names, node counts and allocations are illustrative.
Arcs sit on the side facing their hero's portrait: warrior on top, caster lower right, skirmisher lower left. Gold lines: the selected hero's paths.
Red: bleed, stagger, banners · Yellow: seals, renew · Blue: channeling, fire, ward · Green: poison, combo, haste · Purple: blood magic, curses · Grey: forms
